title: Symmetry of reachability
statement: Let $\mathit{edges}$ be a list of weighted edges on $n$ vertices, and call two vertices reachable when they are joined by a path along these edges (in the sense of the reflexive–transitive closure of symmetric adjacency). Then reachability is symmetric: for all vertices $u, v$, if $u$ is reachable from $v$, then $v$ is reachable from $u$.
